items.author: xnetcat
items.title: [GPU] Encode a command buffer's occlusion prefix sums together
items.note:
Silent Hill: The Short Message was ending each render pass that counted occlusion samples with its own one-thread compute encoder for the prefix sum: about 117 extra encoders per frame. A pass that ends now only queues its prefix sum. The queued sums are encoded together, in pass order, in one compute encoder.
